subject: Mobile Development
title: Sideloading: Freedom or Danger?
description: A short lesson to help you apply Sideloading: Freedom or Danger?.

hook.text: Android lets you install apps from anywhere. Apple says that would destroy iPhone security.

buildup.text: Sideloading means installing apps without going through an official app store.

discovery.text: Android users who sideload face 10x more malware than those who stick to Google Play.

twist.text: The EU's DMA forces Apple to allow sideloading. Apple added heavy restrictions and warnings.

climax.text: Sideloading is a balance between user freedom and platform security that neither side concedes.

punchline.text: Freedom to install anything — including threats.

quiz.question: What is sideloading?
options: Installing apps from outside official app stores
